messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm about to open a canary rollout for v3-model on us-west-2. I want the rollout policy to include: traffic split (5% -> canary), model-variant fallback to v2-quant when v3 latency spikes, region failover to eu-west-1 if us-west capacity drops below 60%, and rate-hedging for tail latencies. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on canary. For clarity: do you want hard thresholds (>=200ms p95) or adaptive thresholds (baseline + 2σ)?

alex: leaning adaptive. Baseline drifts with traffic. If p95 > baseline + 2σ for 2 consecutive 1m windows, trigger async fallback for new requests. Existing requests continue on current connection.

santiago: async fallback sounds safe. We should add a short cool-down (3m) before reverting to canary, and a max-fallback-rate to avoid thundering (like only 30% of canary traffic can be routed to fallback per second).

rachel: Also add a quota guard: if canary error-rate > 1% for 30s, route all new canary traffic to stable. Don't forget to log the reason in rollout events so we can wire alerts.

ops-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for service/inference:v3-model -> 5% traffic on us-west-2 (ts=1799001234)

maria: We should implement regional failover policy as prioritized list: [same-region-fallback, cross-region-fallback], with a per-region health-check TTL of 15s. If us-west-2 capacity < 60% allocatable GPUs for 60s, start failover to eu-west-1 with a 10% ramp per 30s.

alex: Good call. Add model-variant compatibility rules: quantized fallback only allowed if model output schema matches (embedding dims, logits shape). If incompatible, fallback to smaller stable model instead (v1-small).

santiago: For telemetry: emit rollout.metrics: {p95, p50, error_rate, fallback_rate, region_capacity, rollout_state}. Also emit a sparse sample of model outputs (anonymized) to verify semantic parity after fallback.

rachel: UX: Console should show a single rollout timeline with overlays for: traffic split, fallback activations, region failovers, and relevant alerts. Allow manual override to pin traffic to stable and annotate reason.

ops-bot: alert: canary p95 spike detected (1799001500) — p95 = 320ms (baseline+2σ). Auto-fallback engaged: model-variant -> v2-quant for 40% of canary requests. See /runbook/rollouts for details.

alex: Confirmed. Rolling logs show fallback ramp at 10rps increments. Can we make the fallback decision idempotent and deterministic per-request (hash + feature flags) so clients see consistent behavior across retries?

maria: Yes — use request_id sharding with consistent hashing. Also annotate request meta with fallback_reason and fallback_version.

santiago: One edge-case: what if region latency is fine but API quota (per-customer) is exhausted in the target region? Need to check quota gating before failover; if blocked, try next region or fallback variant.

alex: Agreed. Policy precedence: 1) quota gating 2) capacity check 3) model compatibility 4) health checks. Documented in rollout config.

rachel: Small nit: add a "canary isolation" tag so monitoring can group canary vs control traces easily.

alex: I'll draft the rollout config. Example snippet:

rollout:
  id: r-2026-03-18-v3-canary
  target: service/inference
  traffic:
    canary: 0.05
    stable: 0.95
  canary_policy:
    p95_threshold: BASELINE+2SIGMA
    window: 60s
    consecutive_windows: 2
    cool_down: 3m
  fallbacks:
    - type: model_variant
      from: v3-model
      to: v2-quant
      max_fallback_rate: 0.3
    - type: region_failover
      from_region: us-west-2
      to_region: eu-west-1
      capacity_threshold: 0.6
      ramp: 10%/30s
  quotas:
    check_before_failover: true
  telemetry:
    emit: [p95,p50,error_rate,fallback_rate,region_capacity]
    sample_outputs: true

maria: LGTM. Can we also add a "dry-run" flag so Console can simulate the fallback path and surface predicted costs/latency change before enabling?

alex: Yes — dry-run and cost-estimate in Console. Also add an operator action: "force-fallback-for-testing" that requires 2 approvals.

santiago: Can we add a fallback circuit-breaker metric that tracks try->fallback->stable transitions so SREs can tune heuristics?

rachel: I'll mock a Console panel with the timeline + circuit-breaker graph. Tagging @design for quick iterate.

design-bot: design request created: D-4823 (rollout timeline + circuit-breaker UX)

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll open a PR with the config schema and tests for deterministic hashing. Will link here when ready.

ops-bot: deploy: canary config updated (1799003200) — dry-run enabled for rollout r-2026-03-18-v3-canary

alex: PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/infra/rollouts/+/1234 — has unit tests for the adaptive p95 trigger and quota gating. Please review.

maria: Reviewing now :eyes:

santiago: Quick thought after reading PR — add unit test for region fallback when target region has exhausted per-customer quota; expect next region chosen.

alex: Will add that test.
